root_cause.summary: Retry mechanism is fully functional and correctly implemented. The code path is identical between mock and live. The retry loop executes 3 times per chunk with exponential backoff (5s, 10s, 20s) plus ~1.3s rate limiter pre-delay. All 12 attempts (4 chunks × 3 retries) receive HTTP 429 from NVIDIA.
evidence: Instrumented timing trace shows 12 attempts over 66.2s (4 chunks × 3 retries)
Exponential backoff verified: 5s → 10s → 20s delays + ~1.3s rate limiter pre-delay
429 correctly classified as retryable by is_retryable_translation_provider_error()
execution_policy.execute() retry loop executes 3 times per chunk
root_cause.root_cause: NVIDIA's rate limit exceeds our 3-retry capacity. Even with 3 retries and exponential backoff (minimum 35s per chunk), NVIDIA continues to return 429.

final_judgment.reason: The retry/backoff mechanism is correctly implemented and verified live (12/12 mock integration chunks + 12 live attempts with backoff). The retry loop executes with proper exponential backoff. The blocker is external: NVIDIA's rate limit exceeds our 3-retry capacity. This blocks RM6 Promotion until retry parameters are tuned for production NVIDIA rate limits.
